# fhir-harness-validators

The validators fhir-harness's code provides, one folio-validator/v1 node each naming the graph typology and $schema family it checks (bean riit). Owner, 2026-10-04: validators are KG nodes, and the validator names the family. The registry joins each onto its kind.

Part of [FHIR IG Harness](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `fhir-harness-validators`, holding `validators`.
